dedupe_keys.name: synthetic wdn pipe diameter design dataset

description: WDNs-Dataset publishes pipe-level features for 600 synthetic water distribution networks and a Hanoi benchmark. Its README reports 85,745 synthetic pipe samples before outlier removal and 81,829 after preprocessing, with 13 graph and hydraulic features and an optimal commercial pipe-diameter target. The repository names CSV tables and a notebook that trains and evaluates an ANN-WOA diameter predictor. Users can load the tables to train a design surrogate or compare predicted diameters with the Hanoi case; outputs are predictions and error measures. Geographic coverage is synthetic, with Hanoi as a standard test network, not an observed operating utility. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing for the repository. A limitation is that the synthetic generator and optimisation choices determine the feature distribution, and Hanoi alone does not establish transfer to real networks. The tables can calibrate or test water-network design models. No CSV or notebook was downloaded. The related catalogue record model-wntr provides water-network simulation, while these tables contain learned pipe-design examples, not a WNTR network file.
